relations.subject: Harry Charles Purvis Bell
relations.evidence: From 1864 educated at Cheltenham College, but never went to a university.

relations.subject: Harry Charles Purvis Bell
relations.evidence: From 1873 in Ceylon Civil service, served in various positions, finally district judge in Kegalla.

relations.subject: Harry Charles Purvis Bell
relations.evidence: In 1890-1912 the first Archaeological Commissioner for Ceylon with headquarters in Anuradhapura.

relations.subject: Harry Charles Purvis Bell
relations.evidence: Worked long alone, later with a few helpers (D. M. de Z. Wickremasinghe and John Still).
